rules.description: The exact level-aware design graph is canonical, schema-valid, hash-valid, and internally linked.
Users and their evidenced needs are defined for Standard and Critical design work.
Required normal and exception states are present and traversed by exact user-flow references.
Information architecture, continuous responsive behavior, and WCAG 2.2 AA criteria are complete.
The exact Design System revision is selected and all binding company rules are satisfied.
Critical work contains research, usability, security, and privacy UX evidence.
The immutable Design Audit equals a fresh independent audit of the exact current graph and has no blocking finding.
Human approval is APPROVED and bound to the exact current design graph manifest and root.
Every UI issue traces to exact current flows, screens, components, states, responsive targets, accessibility criteria, and Design System revision.
Non-blocking Design Audit findings remain visible.
